# Poly Haven texture sources

The 2K PBR texture maps in `Assets/Northwild/Resources/Textures` come from Poly Haven:

- Forest Ground 03: https://polyhaven.com/a/forrest_ground_03
- Knotted Pine Bark: https://polyhaven.com/a/knotted_pine_bark
- Mossy Rock: https://polyhaven.com/a/mossy_rock

Poly Haven publishes these assets under the CC0 public-domain dedication:
https://polyhaven.com/license

The supplied HDRP mask maps were packed for Northwild as metallic (R), ambient
occlusion (G), detail mask (B), and smoothness (A).
